svg.title: Lactifluus experiments: where CDC adds value for Kubernetes
svg.desc: We tested whether CDC beats cheaper sources. CDC wins on the content and order of a change, not on counting or attribution. We also found a real gap: the operator sees the replication slot grow but does not warn. Next: ask the community whether a content policy is wanted.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: We tested where Change Data Capture beats a plain Postgres counter and the Kubernetes API. 6 experiments, one kind cluster.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: “Metrics are not the product. The product is Kubernetes

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: reacting to the behavior of the data.”

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: For that, CDC must show what cheaper sources cannot.
